description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Data utilities] Date arithmetic offline: adds or subtracts durations (ISO 8601 or plain text, including business days with your weekend and holiday list), and gives the difference to a second date in calendar days, weeks, years/months/days and business days, plus weekday, ISO week, day of year and quarter. Input: date (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO date-time, Unix seconds, today or now), optional add, subtract, until, tz, weekend, holidays. Years 1000-9999.

add.description: Duration to add: ISO 8601 (P1M2D, PT4H) or text (3 days, -2 weeks, 10 business days, 4h 30m; m = minutes, mo = months)

date.description: Date: YYYY-MM-DD, ISO 8601 date-time (2026-11-01T09:30, optional Z or +08:00), Unix seconds, today or now

holidays.description: Dates to skip as holidays in business-day math: up to 400 YYYY-MM-DD, comma-separated

subtract.description: Duration to subtract (same formats as add)

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

tz.description: IANA time zone for today/now and local times (default UTC)

until.description: Second date: returns the difference in days, weeks, years/months/days and business days

weekend.description: Weekend days for business-day math, e.g. sat,sun (default), fri,sat, sun or none

name: date_calc

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: Date calculator: add durations, business days, difference between dates ($0.002/call)
